summary: A +2 glaive that enchants a weapon with elemental damage and makes your Dragonborn breath harder to resist.

fields.Vicious Dragon Breath: Enemies have Disadvantage on saving throws against your Dragonborn racial breath weapon.
fields.Draconic Elemental Weapon: Action once per Long Rest. Touch a weapon or a non-hostile creature holding one in its main hand. Until Long Rest that weapon gains +1 to attack rolls and 1d4 extra Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, chosen when cast.
fields.Stacking: Does not stack with Elemental Weapon or Elemental Age. Can stack with Magic Weapon and Elemental Cleaver.
fields.Base value: 960 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Twinned Spell: The pinned source reports that a Sorcerer can use Twinned Spell to enchant two weapons.
